Free Slots, Challenges, Rewards & Clans. Join 100M+ Players!
Slotomania does not require payment to download and play, but it also allows you to purchase virtual items with real money inside the game, including random items.
Looking for a free casino game packed with slot machines, tournaments, rewards, and daily events?
Welcome to Slotomania, the world's leading free-to-play social casino experience. Spin hundreds of exciting slot machines, collect rewards, join clans, compete against friends, and discover new events every day.
With more than 100 million players worldwide and hundreds of entertaining slot games, Slotomania brings Vegas-style fun right to your mobile device.
 
WHY PLAY SLOTOMANIA?
Hundreds of slot games:
Explore a huge collection of classic favorites and exciting new slot machines, with fresh content added regularly.
Daily rewards and bonuses:
Collect coins, complete missions, and unlock special prizes every day.
Clans and social gameplay:
Join a club, connect with other players, and work together to earn even more rewards.
Collectibles and mini-games:
Complete your SlotoAlbum, unlock rare Slotocards, and enjoy unique mini-games and special events.
New experiences all year long:
Discover seasonal content, limited-time challenges, special events, and exciting rewards.
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
 
What is Slotomania?
Slotomania is a free-to-play social casino game featuring hundreds of slot machines, tournaments, collectibles, daily rewards, and social gameplay.
Can I play Slotomania with friends?
Yes. Join clans, participate in team activities, compete in tournaments, and interact with players from around the world.
 
Do I need real money to play?
No. Slotomania is free to download and play. It is designed for entertainment purposes and does not offer real-money gambling.
 
What can I do besides spinning slot machines?
Collect rewards, complete albums, participate in events, compete in tournaments, unlock achievements, and enjoy social club activities.
 
How often is new content added?
New slot games, events, tournaments, features, and rewards are added regularly to keep the experience fresh and exciting.
Start your journey with a generous Welcome Bonus and discover new ways to play every day. Whether you enjoy rewards, tournaments, clans, or spinning your favorite slot machines, Slotomania always offers something new.
Explore hundreds of slot machine themes, unlock exciting features, and participate in special events.
 
Slotomania is brought to you by Playtika. Earn Playtika Rewards and enjoy benefits across other popular Playtika experiences.
Join millions of players worldwide and discover why Slotomania is one of the world's most popular social casino games.
 
Slotomania is intended for those 21 and older for amusement purposes only and does not offer ‘real money’ gambling, or an opportunity to win real money or real prizes based on game play. Playing or success in this game does not imply future success at ‘real money’ gambling.

You can also find more information about the functionality, compatibility and interoperability of Slotomania in the above description and additional app store information.
